name: Pixel Wilds 🌲 Survival Sandbox
desc:
⛏️ Dig, build YOUR home and survive the night in an endless pixel world!

🏡 Claim your own plot when you join. Everything you build inside it is saved forever.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
⛏️ Dig for ores across 7 biomes: deserts, jungles, mountains, swamps, seas and more
🔨 Make tools, armor and blocks with the recipe book and the furnace
🌙 Survive the night: zombies, skeletons, spiders and the exploding Kegling
🔥 Open a portal to the Underworld and raid its fortress above the lava

✨ ALSO
👁️ The Watcher roams the dark… guard your build!
🐕 Tame a dog that fights by your side
🐝 Keep bees and harvest honey
🚂 Rails, carts and power
⚡ Upgrade your gear at the upgrade table

🎁 REWARDS
👥 Join the group
💌 Invite friends
📅 Daily reward
👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite to help us update faster!

💻 PC: WASD move • Space jump • E inventory • Q drop • 1-9 hotbar
📱 Mobile: full touch controls

llm.loop: dig and mine ores in 7 biomes -> craft tools/armor -> build home on own plot -> survive nights -> portal to Underworld fortress
llm.objectives: survive nights, build home, raid Underworld
llm.progression: tools/armor tier, biomes, portal, upgrade table
llm.instructions: dig, craft, build, survive night, tame dog, daily reward
unique: Minecraft clone with plots saved forever on Roblox
llm.thumbnails: minecraft-like scenes: survive the night, play with friends, open the portal
llm.complexity_notes: voxel world with biomes, crafting, mobs, plots saving; sizable build though a known template
